answer: Require every earning identity to audit a fresh real job: grove irrigation logs, mesa sensor readings, or velvet inventory. Assign the job randomly after a commitment, then draw independent reviewers to check time-stamped evidence. Release capped rewards only after several audits pass. Each extra identity must supply distinct, timely work, so a farm's costs scale with its seats; fabricated evidence removes eligibility. This raises sybil costs without pretending that one account proves one person.
